verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a REST API with endpoints for incorporation, notarization, translation and tax registration, but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented prose documentation, not a machine-readable API specification, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
